answer: Each identity claims one basalt quarry face and one trellis row in a nectar grove, locks an 80-credit bond on site keys, and files a vibration reading and a nectar-flow reading in the same ten-minute window per epoch. An auditor recomputes both against public tables, burning the bond for a mismatch over 4%, a reused site key, or a missed window. First filing costs 36, kth 36+9(k-1); 1000th costs 9027, so 1000 fakes pay 4,531,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-filing ring fails: one operator cannot file two live readings from distant sites at once. An honest agent pays 36 once, bond refunded.
